text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kvcache eviction rate spike + tail latency increase detected on prod-region-us-east-1 at 2026-03-15T02:15:00Z. Error spike: 502s for short requests (<=32 tokens). Auto-run: severity=sev2, routed to oncall_team=infra-oncall.

ben.oncall: I'm on it. Paging ops now and will triage. Any customer-facing alerts yet?

carla-eng: saw the chart — continuous-batching hot change merged yesterday to adjust pack_shed threshold. Could be related. Quick TL;DR: the batcher started grouping long requests with small ones, causing KV cache to be evicted aggressively under memory pressure.

alice.ops: Customers reporting increased 5xx for short tokens; volume concentrated on multi-tenant hosts hgd-*. Notified status page: posting preliminary message.

incident-bot: Status page update posted: "Investigating increased error rates for short inference requests in us-east-1. Engineers responding."

ben.oncall: Ok plan — 1) capture pack_shed + batcher metrics, 2) limit continuous batching to short-only, 3) if needed revert pack_shed config. Carla, can you pull the pack_shed diff and runtime flag values?

carla-eng: grabbing diffs. Patch is in runtime-configs/continuous-batching: changed default pack_shed_threshold from 2MB -> 512KB and turned on cross-tenant packing=true. I think cross-tenant packing + smaller threshold pushed aggressive prefetch/paging.

carla-eng: logs from batch-scheduler node hgd-23:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:43Z] INFO batcher: packed batch (size=1024, longest_req=4096, median_req=28)
[2026-03-15T02:12:43Z] WARN kvcache: eviction_pressure=0.92, inflight_prefetch=120
[2026-03-15T02:13:01Z] ERROR request: id=abc123 route=embeddings short=true status=502 reason="cache_miss_timeout"
```

dave-sre: That eviction_pressure number is the tell. When pack_shed threshold lower, we prefetch more aggressively and we hit page faults. Paging to host swap/pmem causes tail latency.

ben.oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) roll runtime flag cross-tenant packing=false for us-east-1 2) bump pack_shed_threshold back to 2MB 3) enable per-tenant short-request isolation for the hot hosts. Carla, can you push the flag change as a hotconfig?

carla-eng: Pushing hotconfig now to us-east-1 (non-prod already tested). Command:
```bash
./runtime-config apply --cluster=us-east-1 --k=continuous_batching.cross_tenant=false --k=continuous_batching.pack_shed_threshold=2097152 --who=carla-eng --reason="incident rollback"
```

carla-eng: Applied to 60% of nodes (canary). Watching metrics.

ben.oncall: Good. Also fire a pack-shed rollback to runbook: if metrics don't improve in 3 min, scale down prefetchers by 50% and disable prefetch on hgd-* hosts.

alice.ops: Notifying impacted customers via CS handoff: short requests (<=32 tokens) saw 30–40% 5xx between 02:11–02:18 UTC for a subset of hosts. ETA mitigation ~5–10m.

frank-customer-success: getting inbound from two customers, asking if this is a data exposure issue — please confirm not related to auth.

ben.oncall: Confirmed no auth vectors. It's a perf/regression. Tell CS: 'no data access issues, retries recommended until mitigation completes.'

incident-bot: Automation run: auto-scale added +10 nodes to the pool to relieve memory pressure.

carla-eng: Canary nodes show big improvements: eviction_pressure down from 0.92 -> 0.18, short-request p50 latency down 400ms -> 45ms on canary.

dave-sre: Rolling to 100% now. Also applying temporary scheduler fairness override: prefer small requests when mixed queues detected. Rule applied:
```json
{"fairness_override": "small_request_priority", "duration": "15m", "scope": "us-east-1"}
```
(I'm pasting as JSON for the audit log)

ben.oncall: Re-checking customer errors — 5xx rate dropping back to baseline on most tenants. Still seeing a tail on one host group hgd-27.

carla-eng: hgd-27 had atypical disk IO due to pmem reclamation; I've cordoned it and moved traffic off for deeper investigation.

eva-product: What's the customer impact window we should publish in the post-incident summary? We need start/end times and an estimate of affected percent.

alice.ops: Start: 2026-03-15T02:11:30Z (first metric deviation), Mitigation effective: 2026-03-15T02:19:20Z (pack_shed rollback + fairness override fully rolled). Affected requests: ~2.3% of global requests in us-east-1, but for small-request workloads on certain tenants it was 15–60% error spike.

ben.oncall: I'll set the incident severity to sev2 and start the handoff. Next steps for postmortem: root-cause: pack_shed threshold + cross-tenant packing change + insufficient pager-aware canary windows. Contributing: prefetch not bounded by tenant limits and no fairness policy for mixed long/short request scenarios.

frank-customer-success: Notifying prioritized customers with 'investigating -> mitigated' update and offering a one-off quota for retries.

carla-eng: Creating a short-term fix PR to: 1) introduce per-tenant prefetch caps 2) add a safety valve that disables cross-tenant packing if eviction_pressure > 0.6 3) extend canary rollout checks to include eviction_pressure metric.

carla-eng: PR draft link: https://git.internal/r/infra/continuous-batching/pulls/412 (do not merge until postmortem).

dave-sre: Also adding a scheduler rule: when a mixed batch is formed and longest_req > 2x median_req, split the batch to avoid head-of-line blocking for short requests. Quick config:
```yaml
scheduler:
  dynamic_split:
    enabled: true
    longest_to_median_ratio: 2.0
    scope: region
```

ben.oncall: Good. For now the on-call handoff: I'm handing to dave-sre for follow-ups and postmortem. Ben -> DAVE.

dave-sre: Taking it. I'll coordinate the RCA and timeline. Immediate action items assigned: 
- carla-eng: finalize PR with per-tenant caps + safety valve (ETA 4h)
- ops: update status page with final mitigation note and customer impact numbers (ETA 10m)
- sres: add automated alert for eviction_pressure > 0.6 + sustained p95 short-request latency > 200ms (ETA 2h)
- product: decide communications for impacted customers and whether credits needed (eva-product)

eva-product: I will draft the customer comms and sync with frank.

ben.oncall: Closing the active page. If anything regresses, re-open immediately. Great teamwork, folks. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Incident ID: INC-2026-0315-047. Postmortem owner: dave-sre.

dave-sre: Starting timeline capture in #postmortems and will link once draft done. Attaching short metrics snapshot for artifact: 
```text
metric snapshot (us-east-1):
- eviction_pressure: peak 0.92 @02:12 -> 0.18 @02:16
- short_req_5xx_rate: peak 0.40 @02:13 -> 0.03 @02:19
- canary success: modernized nodes show p50 45ms
```

carla-eng: Noted next steps: add unit/regression tests for pack_shed change that simulate mixed workload (500 small + 5 long) and ensure eviction_pressure stays below 0.6 in CI.

frank-customer-success: Follow-up: two customers requested incident writeups, I'll attach postmortem when available.

ben.oncall: Thanks everyone. Handing off pager and sleeping. :zzz:
